notes.subject: ni
notes.rationale: נפש bɛ tɔgɔ-nɔna 'ni' la, a kɔrɔ ka surun ni ma (a ka can, a bɛ balo)

notes.subject: ⟨A⟩
notes.rationale: Heburukan tɛ daɲɛ dɔ sɔrɔ min bɛ furakɛla fɔ; kumasen in bɛ a wajibiya

notes.subject: Job ma
notes.rationale: ɲininkili min bɛ Job kan, a bɛ Bilidad ka kuma laban don

notes.subject: טרף נפשו
notes.rationale: 'a bɛ a yɛrɛ furakɛ' (KJV/JPS, reflekisi) walima 'a bɛ a ni min furakɛ' — Heburukan fɔcogo bɛ a fɔ ko daɲɛ taamasiyɛn dɔrɔn de don

translation: ⟨A⟩ bɛ a ni furakɛ a kɔrɔ kɔnɔ — yala dugukolo bɛna bɔ i n'a ye, walima kabakurun bɛna wuli a yɔrɔ la?
